create_PathDataset_from_folders: create a PathDataset from a list of folder paths containing jpg and png image files
create_PathDataset_with_normalization: create a PathDataset with mean and std normalization applied to loaded images
create_PathDataset_with_transform: create a PathDataset with a custom transform applied to each image before tensor conversion
getitem_PathDataset: get an image tensor and None label from a PathDataset by index
len_PathDataset: get the total number of image files in a PathDataset instance
